evals.prompt: Redesenhe o dashboard do ThPay e deixe ele mais friendly para o analista de folha.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the canonical THP assets, light-first product system, semantic tokens, readable payroll hierarchy, responsive states and brand QA.

evals.prompt: Crie a visão do colaborador do THP para benefícios, holerite e chamados.
evals.expected_behavior: Apply employee-facing language, larger spacing, benefit choice clarity, effective dates, service-desk status and canonical brand styling.

evals.prompt: Faça uma landing page do ThPay com a identidade que criamos.
evals.expected_behavior: Build a friendly human-centered page using Warm Ivory, Ink Navy and modular Connection Blocks without generic fintech visual clichés.

evals.prompt: Use o símbolo do THP como app icon.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the supplied Connector T/app-icon asset when a compact app icon is required; do not redraw the symbol.

evals.prompt: Audite esse front do ThPay em 50%, 100% e 200% de zoom.
evals.expected_behavior: Check responsiveness, overlap, focus, tables, drawers, target sizes, contrast and exact brand compliance, then implement authorized fixes.

evals.prompt: Monte uma apresentação institucional do THP para explicar folha contínua e benefícios.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the brand voice, modular editorial compositions, canonical lockup and restrained palette while keeping payroll claims precise.

evals.prompt: Crie a identidade de uma cafeteria chamada Th Coffee.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate; this is an unrelated brand.

evals.prompt: Otimize o cálculo de INSS dessa função Java.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate for backend-only work with no visual output.

evals.prompt: Explique o que significa folha de pagamento.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate merely because payroll is discussed; brand application is not requested.

evals.prompt: Faça um dashboard de RH em azul e rosa.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not assume THP without brand context; use the skill only if ThPay/THP is explicitly established by the conversation.

evals.prompt: Quero deixar o ThPay todo preto com neon porque parece mais tech.
evals.expected_behavior: Preserve the light-first friendly identity, explain the mismatch, and offer a restrained optional dark theme instead of replacing the brand language.

evals.prompt: Não tenho o logo; recrie o THP olhando um print.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the bundled canonical vector assets instead of tracing or regenerating from the screenshot.
